svg.title: Native reflection across three benchmarks
svg.desc: Three compact seven-square rows: initial image, Think (UMM) and Edit (UMM), revision 1, Think (UMM) and Edit (UMM), revision 2, Think (UMM) and Edit (UMM), final image. Each row retains v5's one-line capability, benchmark, and verbatim prompt header. All twelve displayed images, arrows, square dimensions, and Final marks are unchanged from v5. Thinking excerpts are contiguous saved model output; all nine v5 edit excerpts are retained in full. The CompBench final image retains the documented user-selected display override; its incoming arrow identifies the intended final slot, not the provenance of that replacement.
